basic_info.description: Tucked away on a quaint, one-way street, this stunning 1-bedroom, 1-bath home is a masterpiece of modern design, crafted by the acclaimed David Baker Architect firm celebrated for creating dynamic urban spaces that seamlessly blend form and function. Building is Platinum Certified LEED construction.        Step inside the Air-Conditioned unit to discover a thoughtfully designed layout featuring custom closet storage, hidden blinds throughout, and an effortless flow that maximizes space and natural light. The open-concept living area is perfect for entertaining, while the bedroom offers a serene retreat with smart, built-in storage solutions.        This residence doesn't just impress indoors step outside and take full advantage of the rooftop deck, complete with a BBQ area, stunning city views, and a dedicated dog-friendly space. Other amenities include secure bike parking, a gated entrance, front desk attendance, and a secure package area everything you need for modern city living.        With Trader Joe's just around the corner and Hayes Valley's vibrant boutiques, cafes, and nightlife at your doorstep, you're in the heart of one of the most sought-after neighborhoods.    Pet-friendly, beautifully designed, and packed with top-tier amenities this is city living at its finest
